chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Fadl al-Hashimi, from his father and his uncle, who said:
Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'Applying kohl with antimony (ithmid) aromatises the breath and strengthens the edges of the eyes'.

key_terms.أَشْفَارَ: The edges or lids of the eyes
key_terms.النَّكْهَةَ: The scent or breath, often referring to the scent emanating from the mouth or nose
key_terms.الِاكْتِحَالُ: The act of applying kohl to the eyes
key_terms.الْإِثْمِدِ: Antimony, a mineral used for making kohl

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and physical benefits of using antimony kohl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) highlights the dual spiritual and physical benefits of using antimony kohl, noting it enhances the pleasant scent of the breath (nakhah) and strengthens the eyelids. This hadith from al-Kafi underscores the Prophetic tradition of maintaining personal hygiene and aesthetic beauty as acts of worship, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the integration of bodily care with spiritual refinement.
